title: afzelia palembanica
intro: Afzelia palembanica, commonly known as Palembang ironwood, is a species of tree native to Southeast Asia, particularly in Indonesia and Malaysia. The Palembang ironwood is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Afzelia palembanica include its potential to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its use in traditional medicine to aid in wound healing and skin care. The bioactive constituents of Afzelia palembanica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in the field of phytotherapy.
